about.title: About me
about.p1: I'm Federico, a software engineer based in Córdoba, Argentina. I specialize in building complete products: from the initial client conversation to production deployment.
about.p2: I come from a classical background in Systems Engineering (UTN) and Software Engineering (Siglo 21), but my way of working is modern: I combine engineering judgment with AI tools to deliver faster without sacrificing quality.
about.p3: Before going full-time into this, I taught computer science in high school. That experience gave me something undervalued in this industry: the ability to communicate technical ideas clearly, understand what others need, and transform vague requirements into concrete software.

skills.title: Stack & tools
skills.tagline: I learn what the project requires. Stack is a tool, not an identity.
